data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4: p50 and p95 pre-migration CI review-job duration measured and recorded

## Implementation
Create plugins/dso/scripts/capture_ci_review_baseline.py (standalone, NOT in dso_ci_review package): runs Python runner in dry-run mode N times, measures p50/p95 with time.perf_counter(), writes tests/fixtures/ci-review-baseline.json with captured_at timestamp and regeneration conditions documented.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh passes
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] capture_ci_review_baseline.py exists
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/scripts/capture_ci_review_baseline.py
- [ ] running script produces ci-review-baseline.json
  Verify: python3 plugins/dso/scripts/capture_ci_review_baseline.py && test -f tests/fixtures/ci-review-baseline.json
- [ ] baseline JSON has required fields
  Verify: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('tests/fixtures/ci-review-baseline.json')); assert 'p50_ms' in d and 'p95_ms' in d and 'captured_at' in d"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
data.title: Pre-migration duration baseline capture script
